title: Tau-directed drugs on β12 borophene: docking at the GTP-1 site of Alzheimer paired helical filaments and GFN2-xTB adsorption on a substrate-supported sheet (code and data)
description: Reproducible pipeline and data: PubChem-verified structures of 28 tau-directed and Alzheimer drugs; AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 docking at the GTP-1 site of Alzheimer PHF (PDB 8FUG) with four redocking controls; a planar beta12 borophene sheet with boron restrained to the lattice (substrate-supported model); GFN2-xTB adsorption with a bond-integrity check of every complex; ridge QSPR under nested 5x5 cross-validation, Y-scrambling and applicability domain. run_entire_tau_study.py regenerates every number, table and figure.
